title: Local JavaScript action still declares node20
remediation: Migrate the local action runtime to node24 and test it on supported runners.

title: Third-party action or reusable workflow uses a mutable ref
remediation: Pin third-party actions and reusable workflows to a full commit SHA and document the release tag in a comment.

title: pull_request_target workflow may execute untrusted pull-request code
remediation: Do not checkout or execute the pull request head in a privileged pull_request_target workflow.

title: Self-hosted runner requires an explicit update plan
remediation: Confirm automatic runner updates or document monitoring for GitHub's enforced minimum version.

title: Workflow uses a retired set-output command
remediation: Write step outputs to the GITHUB_OUTPUT environment file.
